text:
sophia (People Ops): @here Quick notice: Seattle office will be closed Sat 2026-06-12 for emergency roof repairs (unexpected leak discovered). Closure window: 06/12 00:00 - 06/13 06:00.

sophia (People Ops): We arranged coworking and support for anyone who planned to be onsite that weekend or needs a daytime workspace Fri 6/11 daytime. Please read details and respond if you need special accommodations.

kevin (Facilities): Short version: roof crew needs full rooftop access Fri night and all day Sat. No building access for non-staff between 20:00 Fri - 06:00 Sun.

emily (People Ops): Coworking options (first-come, no charge for Redwood folks):
```
- SatelliteHub - South Lake Union (3 desks reserved, 08:00-18:00 Fri 6/11)
- HarborWork - Pioneer Square (6 desks reserved, 09:00-17:00 Sat 6/12)
- Remote hotel dayrooms (2 rooms for nursing parents / quiet work, Fri 6/11 08:00-20:00)
```

emily (People Ops): If you need a desk at one of the spaces, reply with which option + preferred 2-hour window. We'll book and share pass codes.

jules: I have a client on Friday afternoon who needs to use a meeting room. Can we reserve one at SatelliteHub?

emily (People Ops): @jules Yes — we can reserve one 3pm-4pm at SatelliteHub. Please DM me attendee list for visitor badges.

chris: Any parking/commute changes for people who planned to come early Sat? I park in Lot D.

kevin (Facilities): Lot D will be gated Sat for crew staging. Park in Lot A (west) Friday evening or use street parking. If you need access to equipment in the office, request an escorted pickup slot via this form: https://forms.company/escorted-pickup. Slots are 30min and require sign-off.

emily (People Ops): Childcare/Family stipend: If you're traveling to Seattle that weekend with dependent care disruption, we can reimburse up to $100 for local childcare or sitter services. Expense code: seattle-closure-26 — upload receipt to Expensify.

sophia (People Ops): Nursing parents: we've booked one of the hotel dayrooms as a private lactation/quiet room Fri 6/11 09:00-18:00. If you need the room outside those hours, DM me and we'll find alternatives.

vendor-bot: Contractor update: Emergency roofer ETA Fri 18:30, crew on-site until ~Sat evening. Weather-dependent.

jules: Will mail/package deliveries be affected? I have a FedEx scheduled Sat morning.

kevin (Facilities): Mailroom will accept packages as usual Fri daytime. Any deliveries scheduled for Sat will be held at the loading dock and distributed Mon morning. If urgent, route to SatelliteHub address (we'll provide details once you request).

chris: I'm on call Sat night and need access to server keys. Is there a plan?

kevin (Facilities): @chris On-call staff who require server-room access after hours will get an escorted badge. Submit a rapid-access request to facilities by 16:00 Fri and we'll coordinate with the roofer crew.

emily (People Ops): Travel reimbursements for folk who were planning to travel in for team events: open to short-notice reimbursements for reasonable non-refundable transit/hotel costs. Expense code: seattle-travel-26. DM People Ops with receipts and a short justification.

sophia (People Ops): If you have sensitive equipment that can't be left (special sensors, lab gear), we can arrange a secured pickup window Fri 6/11 17:00-19:00. Please list items here or DM me.

jules: Thanks for organizing — will move my 6/12 session to SatelliteHub.

emily (People Ops): Summary checklist: please react with :white_check_mark: if you need any of: coworking desk / childcare stipend / escorted pickup / early lactation room / extra parking help. We'll triage slots tomorrow.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Seattle Office - Emergency Roof Repairs" 2026-06-12 - 2026-06-13. Location: Seattle Office / SatelliteHub fallback.

sophia (People Ops): Final note: if this closure affects vendor or candidate interviews, please reschedule or loop in People Ops and Facilities so we can handle visitor logistics. We'll send one more reminder Fri morning.

emily (People Ops): Contact for this event: Kevin (Facilities) or Sophia (People Ops) via Slack or pager.

chris: Appreciate the support — I'll request escorted access for server keys now.

jules: :thumbsup:
